title: I’ve never been disappointed, giftable!
text: I’ve never been disappointed, giftable!. This is my third set of KAF kitchen towels that I’ve gifted. As am I, everyone loved their gift! This one was extra special as I sent it out of state to my granddaughter. She chose “Home For The Holiday’s”, and I certainly wish she could be this year!

product_metadata.title: KAF Home Kitchen Holiday Digitally Printed Dish Towel Set of 4, 100-Percent Cotton, 18 x 28-inch (Holiday Truck)
features: PERFECT FOR THE HOLIDAYS: Set of 4 includes: 1 digitall printed front towel and 3 Yarn Dye towels as shown in image.
JUST THE RIGHT SIZE: Each towel is 18 x 28-Inch in size unwashed and then Minimal Shrinkage may occur after washing / drying
CONVENIENCE IS KEY: Each towel comes with a convenient sewn in loop for easy hanging
THE PERFECT GIFT: These holiday sets will make a splash for your kitchen décor, this Kitchen Dish Towel Set of 4 is ideal for your own home or makes a lovely housewarming gift
EASY CARE: 100-Percent Cotton, Made in India. Wash in Cold Water with like colors, Dry in warm dryer
